channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jonathan Kuminga | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jonathan Kuminga from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Matt Lloyd on Alonzo Gee, Chris Finch, Tim Connelly, Anthony Edwards, Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Matt Lloyd:

“The opportunity came up to sign Jonathan Kuminga, which again was the product of many, many phone calls and a lot of time investment. My wife asked me at one point, how many times has he called you? She was referencing Jonathan Kuminga's agent. How many times have you been on the phone with him since the middle of July? So I said, okay, I will look, and we went through my phone and we had 94 phone calls between July 15th to the day we signed Jonathan. Anthony Edwards was really instrumental in recruiting him to come here. We had several conversations with him, his representatives, and from Chris Finch to Tim Connelly to Alonzo Gee, who is on our staff, everything just came together.”

Matt Lloyd on Alonzo Gee, Chris Finch, Tim Connelly, Anthony Edwards, Jonathan Kuminga, Sep 19, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Ziaire Williams on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Ziaire Williams:

“Yeah, I do, and I mean that's the GM's job, right to put the best pieces together to try to win a championship. I don't think it's altered whether or not Kuminga was here. I wish him the best of luck in Minnesota, but as a team, we’re focused on the guys we have and making a deep playoff run and winning an NBA championship and I think we have the tools to do so.”

Ziaire Williams on Jonathan Kuminga, Sep 13, 2026. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: CJ McCollum on Jonathan Kuminga:

“We're not up 2-1 without him. We're thankful to have and we'll make sure we take good care of him here in the A”

CJ McCollum on Jonathan Kuminga, Apr 24, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't:Quin Snyder on Kuminga:

“Jonathan's just been all in...tonight he did some things that really gave our team a lift. I think the biggest thing he's done is he's just defended. Another guy that's in there competing and defending”

Quin Snyder on Jonathan Kuminga, Apr 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
“You're usually not drafted to a team that's good enough to compete and win a championship that year. That's the hand Jonathan Kuminga was dealt. And so I appreciate the way he handled it, the maturity he showed in handling the situation the entire time, even when the writing was on the wall and everybody in the world kind of knew a trade was going to happen.”

Draymond Green on Jonathan Kuminga, Feb 10, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Mike Dunleavy on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Mike Dunleavy on the Jonathan Kuminga trade demand:

“I’m aware of that. In terms of demands, when you make a demand there needs to be demand.”

Mike Dunleavy on Jonathan Kuminga, Jan 20, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Steph Curry on the persistent Jonathan Kuminga trade chatter:

“It’s not a distraction at all. It’s a very unique situation. Our job is to keep playing, keep winning. It’ll resolve itself one way or the other.”

Stephen Curry on Jonathan Kuminga, Jan 16, 2026. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga’s path back into Golden State’s rotation:

“It's tough because he's not really a short-minute player. I played a bunch of guys eight, 10 minutes. JK is a guy who needs his rhythm. He's not like a Gui (Santos) who's going to come in or Pat (Spencer) and just fly around and play with great energy for four minutes and come out. He needs some rhythm. He always has to stay ready. There's a pathway there, but right now, it's not there. But things change quickly in the NBA.”

Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga, Dec 30, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga:

“I’m really urging for him to get up the floor instead of holding back and asking for the ball.”

Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga, Dec 6, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga:

“The way he’s rebounding, the way he’s attacking the rim, that’s what makes him special. When he’s playing to that talent, to that ability, it changes our team.”

Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga, Oct 28, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Jimmy Butler on the Kuminga stalemate:

“Itwill get handled. I know both sides will be happy in the end.”

Jimmy Butler on Jonathan Kuminga, Sep 29, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Dunleavy on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Mike Dunleavy on Jonathan Kuminga’s desire (or non-desire) to be with Warriors factoring into restricted free agency:

“I think from his end, ultimately he’s the one that has to sign the contract. If it happens with us, it’s reflective of his desire to be here.”

Mike Dunleavy on Jonathan Kuminga, Jun 26, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Steve Kerr, Jordan Poole, Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
DeMarcus Cousins:

“I think they lost (Kuminga). I think Steve Kerr ruined that relationship with the DNPs. We've seen this happen time and time again when it comes to him and dealing with young talent. He just doesn't handle young talent well. He doesn't develop young talent. I mean, out of the years he's been there, we've seen one guy develop under Steve Kerr—and they ran him off as well—and that was Jordan Poole. So when it comes to young talent, I just don't think they handle it well. And I can see Kaminga being on the move.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Steve Kerr, Jordan Poole, Jonathan Kuminga, May 21, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
95.7 The Game: Steve Kerr on if Jonathan Kuminga returns to Golden State:

“If JK comes back, we will for sure spend the early part of the season playing him with Jimmy, Draymond, Steph. To me that would be a no brainer. We didn't have that luxury this year.. We've basically been in the playoffs since the minute we got Jimmy and that was also when JK got hurt.”

Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga, May 16, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chris Finch on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Kerith Burke:Chris Finch on the dedensive plan for Jonathan Kuminga in game 4:

“I think you got to be a little bit more physical. I think he was dictating physicality on his matchup offensively, we got to try to stand up his drives a little bit earlier.”

Chris Finch on Jonathan Kuminga, May 12, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Dalton Johnson:Draymond on Jonathan Kuminga’s defense tonight:

“We challenged him in private, we challenged him publicly to step up on the defensive end and he did that. He was great offensively, but he was even better defensively.”

Draymond Green on Jonathan Kuminga, Apr 4, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steph Curry on Jonathan Kuminga:

“I think we need to just let this guy play basketball. We don’t have to have a declaration after every game. We don’t have to be in a situation where we are judging every minute he’s out there.”

Stephen Curry on Jonathan Kuminga, Apr 4, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
“What makes Jimmy special is that he doesn’t try to be special. He plays fundamental basketball. He never turns it over. He just makes the simple play over and over. I want JK to learn some of that … attacking the rim, nothing there, jump stop, pass the ball. That’s a great basketball play. JK before he got hurt, it was the best I’ve ever seen him play. He was already on a great track. This was just a reminder that these are the things we want.”

Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga, Feb 27, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Jimmy Butler on Jonathan Kuminga:

“Hella athletic. Can shoot it. Can score it in a multitude of ways. And can guard. I think he’s going to come back and do what he’s been doing. My job is to make it even easier on him. So come on back and help us get some dubs.”

Jimmy Butler on Jonathan Kuminga, Feb 26, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
“And just be free. [I was] just happy that I got to play. I was kind of unsure going into the day. I didn't get many attempts in the first half, but all four of them are really good in-rhythm shots and then from there you're kind of just flowing off of the joy of things going our way and having a day where Dennis [Schroder] hit three in the first half, JK [Jonathan Kuminga] came in and hit some big shots, Moses [Moody], everybody was kind of just feeling the rhythm of the night.”

Stephen Curry on Jonathan Kuminga, Jan 3, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Draymond Green on Jonathan Kuminga:

“You shouldn’t love coming off the bench. But how you respond is important…Notonly should we talk about his play, we should talk about his maturity.”

Draymond Green on Jonathan Kuminga, Nov 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Before the first Pelicans game, it was announced that Kuminga was benched, and it was a complete overreaction. The lineup change was because Steph wasn’t out there, so we needed more shooting, more spacing. So instead of JK, we added Moses and Buddy to spread the floor. If not, they were just going to zone us, clog the paint, and make it hard for everyone. That’s not a knock on JK, if anything, it’s probably a knock on me and Trace. But the media tried to blow it up, like they always do. JK approached it with the right mindset, came out hard, and the lineup change actually sparked him. He had his best two games of the season so far because of it.”

Draymond Green on Jonathan Kuminga, Nov 1, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Trayce Jackson-Davis, Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Steve Kerr on the if he'll keep the Draymond-Jackson-Davis combination together as starters after Kuminga returns:

“My philosophy is always if you're playing well, you keep doing the same thing.”

Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Trayce Jackson-Davis, Jonathan Kuminga, Apr 4, 2024. Source: Twitter @kendra__andrews.

item.title: Joe Lacob on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
“Warriors CEO Joe Lacob raved about Golden State’s 21-year-old forward Joanthan Kuminga, who he sees as a player who is capable of achieving everything and anything in the NBA. “Draymond’s suspension, as he said in his comments the other day, ironically, may have, long-term, made us better in an odd sort of way because JK got to get the leash taken off and play,”

Joe Lacob on Jonathan Kuminga, Feb 15, 2024. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
CJ Holmes:Draymond Green on Jonathan Kuminga's impact in recent games:

“It’s beautiful. You felt the impact. I know we’ve 100% felt and seen the impact. And the reality is, what it boils down to is energy, effort and attention to detail when you’re a young guy.”

Draymond Green on Jonathan Kuminga, Nov 27, 2022. Source: Twitter @CjHolmes22.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Kerith Burke:Kerr on Kuminga:

“We’ve spent a lot of time together since camp started and he's been very coachable. He listens. Works really hard. You know, the biggest thing is, he just needs more time. And not just game reps, but practice reps and experience in the NBA game.”

Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga, Nov 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @KerithBurke.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga positionally:

“He’s a 4 right now. He still has a lot of growth ahead of him skill wise. In the future I could see him playing 3 or 4.But right now, for this team, with the lineups we need spacing, which puts him at the 4.”

Steve Kerr on Jonathan Kuminga, Oct 29, 2022. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Bob Myers, Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
In a podcast hosted by The Athletic’s Tim Kawakami, Kerr revealed that he and GM Bob Myers were perplexed by the rumblings about Jonathan Kuminga’s alleged behavior.

“I know there was that weird report that came out, I think Stephen A. Smith said something about [Kuminga], and honestly, Bob [Myers] and I when that came out, called each other and asked each other ‘where did that come from?'”

Steve Kerr on Bob Myers, Jonathan Kuminga, Sep 22, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Andre Iguodala on Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
“He’s over there right now playing in their international games. Kuminga’s getting busy. I mean fastbreak, reverse, pull-ups, he’s in his bag. ISOs, getting to it, making shots. But every clip, they down 20, 25.”

Andre Iguodala on Jonathan Kuminga, Sep 4, 2022. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Jonathan Kuminga, Moses Moody
item.description:
to coach Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Jonathan Kuminga and Moses Moody getting more minutes next season :

“Sure, we'll like it. But if there are guys playing better, we'll play those guys.”

Steve Kerr on James Wiseman, Jonathan Kuminga, Moses Moody, Jun 22, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.
